added.summary: HudBar measures a shield too (kind shield: --hud-shield-fill and --hud-shield-glow, in cells with segment), so a shooter's armour bar is the same block as an RPG's health bar.
One token each for a HudSlot ultimate's ring (gold by default) and a harmful HudEffect's tag ink (--hud-harm by default), so a HUD family sets its own on the place it gives the block.
